title: Chapter 142: Decapitate The Evil Typha Tree (2)
content:
Chapter 142: Decapitate The Evil Typha Tree (2)

Chapter 142: Decapitate the Evil Typha Tree (2)

“Boom!”

A loud explosion rang in the air. The Evil Typha Tree saw itself being devoured slowly, and its struggling became weaker. The main root tore into the ground, wanting to reach the deepest part of the earth to stop the sucking power!

“Pfufff”

At this moment, an incomparable power appeared from under the earth helped the main root.

“Boom!”

After being assisted by this power, the Evil Typha Tree began to stabilize, and then it pulled down the dao platform instead. The dao platform turned bright as it was being dragged by the evil tree.

“Booom—”

In a short time, the whole world shook, and the Evil Typha Tree furiously pulled with its roots, wanting to yank the dao platform.

“What is going on here?”

Seeing the sudden reversal of the situation, Li Shuangyan and Chen Baojiao were frightened and lost their colors. Once the Evil Typha Tree captured the dao platform, they could only die.

“The Evil Typha Tree managed to devour such a rare thing, this growth is not unreasonable.”

Li Qiye was still calm, and idly said with a smile:

“Underground is an evil vein, with evil spring water. This evil spring water is extremely valuable to the Evil Typha Tree. If the tree could use it to refine its body, one day it would become an existence existing alongside the gods.”

“Boom-”

Suddenly, the black hole doubled in size. The clanking sounds of the iron chains hitting each other as the universal laws restricting the Evil Typha Tree contracted several times more, pulling it into the black hole.

“Bang—-”

The earth was overturned. This scene was like a heavenly ox plowing through the world, creating countless holes of dirt and mud.

At this second, even connecting to the evil vein was useless and couldn’t stop it from being dragged into the black hole. A section of its roots was devoured into pieces.

“Clank, clank, clank…”

But now, an even more horrifying event occurred. The bony outgrowths of the tree that were sucking in evil energy in the sky rushed to the mountain of bones, and all the evil energy started to condense there instead.

At this moment, all the bones connected together, no matter whether they were human bones, heavenly beast’s bones, or stone statues’ remnants, everything were assembled together into a huge giant skeletal tree.

This giant skeletal tree appeared in front of Li Qiye, like a giant monster, and struck down towards the dao platform with its monstrous body.

“Boom!”

The entire platform was shaken from the impact, but the black hole became even larger and more powerful as it continued to drag the Evil Typha Tree.

“Bang—Bang–Bang”

At this point, the giant tree gripped the dao platform, wanting to crush it into pieces.

“Shit, this evil thing became much stronger!”

Inside the protection sphere, the group of Niu Fen’s expressions greatly changed from this crazy grotesque scene.

“Bang–”

However, the Evil Typha Tree was far more frightening than that. At this time, a bony outgrowth bursted out from the ground.

This bony outgrowth was ten thousand zhang high, thick and terrifying. It turned into a giant hammer, and slammed down with a destructive force on the dao platform.

“Boom–”

Being stuck by this horrifying hammer, the dao platform was shaking nonstop, and even the black hole suffered from the impact, and its power decreased.

“Booom–Boom–”

Both the bony outgrowth along with the giant tree made from bones repeatedly slammed the dao platform, wanting to render it into nothingness. The black hole became weaker from the impact, leaving the Evil Typha Tree room to breath. In a short time, their attack became even more rapid.

“I’m afraid the dao platform won’t be able to handle this. We should run away, if this ghastly thing escapes, then it would be our end.”

Niu Fen lost his colors, and glanced at Li Qiye while speaking.

“Still a piece of cake.”

Li Qiye was still calm, and looking at the Evil Typha Tree with its evil energy soaring the sky, and smiled:

“I originally didn’t want to kill you, but since you don’t know life from death, I’ll help you.”

Finished speaking, Li Qiye formed miscellaneous seals with his hands, stomping his feet on the ground, and shouted. Blood energy rushed into the sky, and he chanted true mantras:

“Obey my will, open the Emperor Xue Xi’s Dimension. Descent, Slaughtering Evil Formation!”

“Boooom— Boom–”

At this moment, an unimaginable scene occurred. The entire space of the Evil Infested Ridge was illuminated with a bloody light. In the horizon, there was a giant door opening, unleashed an endless terrible emperor aura. When the lights intermixed with each other, in the sky, the celestials appeared and the world rotated, giving birth to a huge complex formation.

“Whooosh—-”

In a flash, a bloody spear belonging to the gods descending from the sky in order to destroy evils and all existences.

“Bang—”

The blood spear pierced down and destroyed the long bony outgrowth, penetrated countless bones. Under this one spear, whether it was the bony outgrowths or part of the giant skeleton mountain, everything was drilled through, unable to resist its power.

Even the Heavenly Beasts and Longevity Spirits were shivering from feeling the presence of the Immortal Emperor. One million year old Heavenly Beasts and Longevity Spirits were all hiding in their caves, not daring to venture out.

“Oh heavens, the sky itself is a killing formation!”

Even an expert like Niu Fen lost the strength in his knees as he watched the emperor’s gate opening and the appearance of the grand formation creating the blood spear. He emotionally exclaimed:

“This… This is a grand formation of the Immortal Emperor rank. Anyone… anyone who meets this will surely die.”

Chen Bao Jiao and the old servant were needless to say also speechless from this incredible scene ahead. This bloody spear was indeed capable of killing gods and devils.

After a while, Chen Baojiao regained her wits and still pale, asked Li Qiye:

“You.. you had this technique since way earlier right?”

This beauty capable of toppling kingdoms even when pale was still enough for others to yearn and love.

Chen Baojiao and the old servant finally understood at this point that in since the beginning, Li Qiye already had a victorious method. From the very start, Li Qiye wanted to kill all sects and cultivators coming into the Evil Infested Ridge!

This was when they understood that whether it was the Azure Mysterious Ancient Kingdom, Heavenly God Sect, or even the entire world, everything was within his calculation. He was the one who spread the rumors that Sheng Tian Dao wanted what was called the “treasure of the gods”.

In the end, too many people died here, and only a few escaped.

The old servant had experienced many waves and winds, but his palm was still shaking with cold sweat. At this point, he was secretly glad that they weren’t the enemies of Li Qiye, or even if he was stronger, they would still be doomed.

Li Qiye simply glanced at Chen Baojiao and said:

“Evil Infested Ridge is the personal property of the Cleansing Incense Ancient Sect. As the prime disciple, it is nothing strange that I know certain methods.”

Of course, this grand formation didn’t have anything to do with Immortal Emperor Min Ren. This was prepared by Immortal Emperor Xue Xi. At that time, they prepared this grand formation in the sky as an inescapable net, wanting to destroy the Evil Typha Tree.

Unfortunately, before they could do anything, the Six Dao Lotus had already made a move against the Evil Typha Tree, so they didn’t get a chance to use their preparation.

Killing the tree was led by the Dark Crow Li Qiye, but because the formation was not used, Li Qiye left it behind, hoping to make good use of it one day.

Today, Li Qiye clashed his hands together with mysterious seals while chanting profound words to open this emperor gate and summoned the descending blood spear to destroy the evil existence.

“Zhiiiiiiii—-”

At this time, the Evil Typha Tree miserably shrieked, the blood spear had pierced through its body and its roots were slain even more.

“Poof–”

The main root of the Evil Typha Tree was split open. Inside was an ancient root around the size of a finger flying forward, wanting to escape as far away as possible!

“What is that?”

Seeing the ancient root wanting to escape, Li Shuangyan asked with astonishment.

“Progenitor root.”

Li Qiye looked at the extreme speed of the progenitor root, and said:

“The tree is not an adult Evil Typha Tree, so it only had such a tiny progenitor root.”

“Are you not killing it?”

Niu Fen was also worried. If the progenitor root could grow up to be an adult Evil Typha Tree, once it escaped, the consequences could only be imagined. This would be a great disaster ah…

“It does not understand this world, and does not understand this heaven and earth!”

Li Qiye smiled and said.

As they were talking, the finger sized progenitor root wanted to escape far and far away.

As the root was flying out of the eastern region, the Cassia Lotus Tree in the far south made a buzzing sound. Suddenly, a green branch rushed forward like a sword of the gods. It suddenly slashed the horizon, capable of ending the karmic cycle and destroy all six dao.

It was only a young branch, but at this moment, even the gods would tremble. This branch was slashing out just like a sacred sword.

“Xshhhh—”

The young branch rendered the progenitor roots into innumerable pieces under its godly power!
